subject: Fix connection tree jumping to a random "...Research" connection
body:
Fix connection tree jumping to a random "...Research" connection

ConnectionTreeWindow.txtSearch defaults to the localized placeholder
text "Search" (Language.SearchPrompt). ApplyFiltering()'s
UseFilterSearch branch correctly treats that placeholder as "no
search", but the non-filter (NodeSearcher) branch did not - so with
UseFilterSearch off (the default), the literal string "Search" was
used as a search term.

NodeSearcher.SearchByName does a case-insensitive substring match, and
"Search" is a substring of "Research" - so this silently matched the
first connection in the tree with "research" in its name/description/
hostname and called JumpToNode on it, expanding its parent folders and
selecting it. The result becomes visible whenever the connection tree
panel repaints (e.g. after closing Options), even though nothing was
actually searched for.

Add the same placeholder check the filter-search branch already has.

triage.rationale: Prevents the tree view from jumping to a matching node (like 'Research') when the search text is empty or shows the 'Search' placeholder.

votes.concern: Exact placeholder comparison prevents searching for a connection named exactly like the localized prompt.
votes.reason: Current code still searches the placeholder in non-filter mode, causing unintended selection; this one-line guard matches existing filter behavior and is low-risk.

votes.concern: None. Extremely low risk change that prevents searching for the placeholder text.
votes.reason: Prevents the connection tree from jumping to a matching node when the search prompt placeholder text is active and filter-search is disabled.
